source: calibration run, recorded by hand from the original walk-forward backtest
note: This is the reference point every later `radar validate` run is compared against. It was measured before the command existed, on the same method the command implements: score on the first 45 days of stored history, measure the next 45. Re-run `radar validate` on your own database to produce a comparable entry with your full universe.
verdict: HOLDING UP. rho = +0.24, top quintile +37.8% mean against +28.5% for all eligible.
caveats: The whole market rose over this window, which is why even the bottom quintile is positive. The edge is the spread, not the headline.
Survivorship bias: the universe was drawn from cards worth $10+ TODAY, so cards that collapsed out of that band are missing.
One window, one game, n=117. Three of the top 23 lost money and the best card in the bottom quintile returned +197%.
